property_summary: For any caller-authorized (admin) setOwner that does not revert, C always returns success == true regardless of the argument (even when the new owner equals the current owner), while the mutant returns false whenever the new owner equals the old owner; the fuzzed seed chooses the target address, with the seed that maps to the current owner exposing the difference.
change_summary: Return whether the new owner differs from the old one instead of always true.
